answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through thermal attestation. Nodes maintain identity by submitting cryptographic proofs of heat radiated from their silicon. An attacker incurs the verifiable electricity cost of running dedicated hardware per persona. Whether stationed at a coastal jetty, a polar glacier, or a juniper ridge, each agent must consume real energy. However, ambient climate variations give an unfair thermodynamic advantage to operators in freezing regions.
